service.name: Alexander Raids (Savage)
service.longDescription: In the Dravanian hinterlands rises Alexander, a colossal primal of steel and steam summoned by the Illuminati. Within its iron frame, the goblins’ mad designs churn on — dare you shut the machine god down from the inside?

rewards.title: Savage Gear
rewards.text: Gordian, Midan & Alexandrian gear ranging from ilvl 210 to 275 depending on the tier.

rewards.title: Exclusive Glamour & Minion Drops
rewards.text: Exclusive glamour and collectibles from the savage fights.

rewards.title: Achievement: “Sins of the Savage Creator I” & More
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating Heavensward Savage Tier.
